DIFF_ATTACK_SURFACES: Contract and serialization attack: case declarations, producer-calculated digests, capability labels, or normalized transcripts could counterfeit complete evidence without crossing the claimed behavior boundary.

State and resource attack: streaming credits, cancellation, body and metadata ceilings, socket workers, or pooling identities could leak state, over-allocate, deadlock, or survive a rejected operation.
Integration attack: internal redirect, cookie, DNS, SSRF, retry, proxy, compression, HTTP/2, or fingerprint helpers could be mistaken for a composed public transport capability.
Gate attack: a self-consistent fabricated report, stale fixed report path, incomplete source digest, or undeclared executed proof class could pass a producer-aligned validator.
INDEPENDENT_CHECKS_RUN: Oracle-integrity reviewer Anscombe independently inspected manifest completeness, semantic projection, producer/consumer separation, counterfactual discrimination, and report fabrication paths; the final verdict was PASS.

Transport-security reviewer Halley independently inspected capability visibility, SSRF and redirect behavior, cookie scope, fingerprint downgrade, empty-capability execution, and blocked-capability honesty; the final verdict was PASS.

Resource-architecture reviewer Poincare independently inspected byte credits, allocation preflight, cancellation acknowledgement, worker reaping, timing and limit evidence, report identity, and canonical gate integration; the final verdict was PASS.

The primary reran the 22-test transport suite, mutation-sensitive report consumer, warnings-denied workspace Clippy, two fresh 54-case corpus runs, architecture gate, runtime-truth gate, and deep gate after all reviewer findings were remediated.
COUNTERFACTUAL_CHECKS: The strict consumer independently reconstructs the semantic projection, mutates one accepted semantic fact, and proves the same comparison rejects that altered report.
A self-consistent fabricated report with a recomputed producer digest is rejected against the independently pinned canonical semantic projection digest.
A blocked mandatory capability forces FAILED_SPIKE_REQUIRES_OPERATOR_DECISION even when every case observation exactly matches its declared blocked outcome.
The deep-gate report contract now declares the counterfactual proof class executed by architecture fixtures, with a focused regression assertion preventing declaration drift.
BOUNDARY_PROBES: HTTP/1.1 range and streaming evidence crosses a real authenticated loopback socket with frozen normalized request and response hashes.
Streaming uses synchronized fragment receipt and acknowledgement so four exact byte-credit operations are observed rather than inferred from a final buffer.
Huge Content-Length is rejected before allocation and records the exact maximum and observed values; metadata, body, and byte-credit boundaries likewise record concrete limit evidence.
Cancellation shuts down a partial real socket operation, joins the client worker, and reaps the bounded local server worker before evidence is accepted.
NEGATIVE_PATH_CHECKS: Manifest validation rejects unknown fields, duplicate case IDs, missing canonical cases, omitted semantic capabilities, and supported families without positive, boundary, and negative coverage.
The adapter rejects an empty requested-capability set, forbidden redirect destinations, special-use DNS answers, rebinding, cross-origin IP cookies, and byte-credit overrun.

Fingerprint, HTTP/2, proxy address evidence, compression, decompression bounds, redirect integration, cookie PSL, DNS provenance, SSRF registry, pool execution context, and retry execution remain exact typed blockers and never execute as weaker HTTP.
Secret query, header, and Location canaries are sanitized from reports, while forged blocked-capability state and behavior mutations are rejected by executable tests.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.finding: The initial strict consumer could accept a self-consistent fabricated report after an attacker recomputed the producer-owned semantic digest.
Incomplete policy helpers and a generic candidate execution surface could be mistaken for publicly supported transport capabilities.
Initial resource receipts did not bind all ceiling decisions to concrete maximum and observed values at the allocation and credit boundaries.
Canonical gate artifacts initially named a stale fixed transport-report path instead of the exact unique report produced by that execution.
Deep verification executed architecture counterfactual fixtures without declaring counterfactual as a supported proof class in its report.

RESIDUAL_UNCERTAINTY: The candidate does not prove browser TLS or HTTP/2 fingerprint parity, HTTP/2 transport, authoritative public-suffix cookie handling, proxy peer-address evidence, resolver provenance and complete special-use registry enforcement, integrated redirects, compression/decompression bounds, real pool execution context, or an integrated retry executor.

The deterministic corpus uses bounded local HTTP/1.1 sockets and does not establish live-site compatibility, cross-platform behavior beyond this Windows run, network replacement parity, or Ferric application behavior.
A later application consumer must select an Operator-authorized dependency path and re-prove the exact staged artifact through FF-GATE-RUNTIME-001.

risk_scenarios.risk: Ordinary HTTP success is mistaken for fingerprint compatibility.
risk_scenarios.failure_scenario: Requests succeed against generic servers while mandatory wire/TLS/HTTP2 fingerprints fail on target cases.
risk_scenarios.mitigation_and_hardening: Require explicit requested/satisfied fingerprint and wire identities and gate selection on mandatory fingerprint corpus outcomes.
risk_scenarios.verification_needed: Known-sensitive deterministic or controlled cases distinguish required profiles and fail on wrong/absent wire identity.

risk_scenarios.risk: Pool reuse crosses credential or fingerprint boundaries.
risk_scenarios.failure_scenario: A connection created for one cookie, proxy, TLS, client-certificate, or fingerprint context serves another.
risk_scenarios.mitigation_and_hardening: Include every behavior/security-affecting input in immutable pool keys and expose normalized key identity for tests.
risk_scenarios.verification_needed: Pairwise and generated partition tests show incompatible contexts never reuse a connection; compatible contexts may reuse only as declared.

risk_scenarios.risk: Redirect, DNS rebinding, or proxy behavior bypasses SSRF policy.
risk_scenarios.failure_scenario: A permitted URL resolves or redirects to loopback/private/special-use space, or proxy mode hides destination evidence and proceeds.
risk_scenarios.mitigation_and_hardening: Revalidate every submitted/redirected/nested URL, validate all resolved addresses, bind to one approved result, and reject operations requiring unavailable proxy destination evidence.
risk_scenarios.verification_needed: IPv4/IPv6 special-use, mixed-result, rebinding, redirect-chain, nested-resource, and untrusted-proxy cases fail closed.

risk_scenarios.risk: Streaming, decompression, retries, or cancellation become unbounded.
risk_scenarios.failure_scenario: A slow/expanding/retrying response consumes unbounded bytes or leaves a poisoned reusable connection after cancellation.
risk_scenarios.mitigation_and_hardening: Require byte credits before acceptance, metadata/body/decompression/redirect/retry ceilings, deadlines, cancellation acknowledgement, and explicit pool discard/reuse state.
risk_scenarios.verification_needed: Slow, infinite, zip-bomb, reset, retry-storm, one-over-limit, cancel-race, and stalled-consumer probes remain bounded.

risk_scenarios.risk: Candidate transitively introduces forbidden native or build artifacts.
risk_scenarios.failure_scenario: Default features, build scripts, FFI, Cargo links, downloads, or prebuilt binaries violate the approved boundary.
risk_scenarios.mitigation_and_hardening: Inspect features/source/build scripts/transitive graph and clean artifacts, disable defaults, pin lockfile, and fail architecture policy on undeclared mechanisms.
risk_scenarios.verification_needed: Cargo metadata, source/build scans, lockfile, clean-artifact smoke, and linkage/provenance inspection pass with prohibition mutation fixtures.
